rules.statement: In a partition action, there is a duty cast on the Judge to satisfy himself as to the identity of the land sought to be partitioned, and for this purpose it is always open to him to call for further evidence (in a regular manner) in order to make a proper investigation.
rules.supporting_quote: Held - In a partition action there is a duty cast on the Judge to satisfy himself as to the identity of the land sought to be partitioned, and for this purpose it is always open to him to call for further evidence (in a regular manner) in order to make a proper investigation.
